definition_zh: 热切；渴望；贪求；（医学）结合力
definition_en: eager eagerness or keen desire; also, in medicine, the strength with which antibodies bind
core_image: 扑向书页的那双手，快得像怕词会飞走
scene: 新期刊刚到，学生就扑了过去。She read the papers with an avidity that startled her tutor.
sceneCN: 这里 avidity 指「热切、如饥似渴」（第 1 个义项：强烈的渴望）；句意：她如饥似渴地读那些论文，导师都吃了一惊。

pos.zh: 热切；渴望；贪求；（血清学）亲合力

derivatives.zh: 热切的；渴求的（avidity 的形容词基础）

senses.title: Eager enthusiasm for something
senses.definition: keen, impatient eagerness toward an activity or pursuit
senses.definitionCN: 对某项活动或追求急切而强烈的热情
senses.example: The class listened with an avidity rare in exam season.
senses.exampleCN: 全班听得入神，考试季罕有如此热切。
senses.why: The Latin root avidus means eager; the noun names eagerness itself.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 avidus 意为「渴望」，名词即渴望本身。

senses.title: Greed for food or pleasure
senses.definition: intense appetite, especially for food or enjoyment
senses.definitionCN: 强烈的欲望，尤指对食物或享乐
senses.example: The travelers ate with the avidity of the half-starved.
senses.exampleCN: 旅人们以半饥者的贪馋狼吞虎咽。
senses.why: Older English kept the animal sense of appetite beside the noble one.
senses.whyCN: 早期英语中，食欲的本能义与求知的高雅义并存。

senses.title: Greed for gain
senses.definition: covetous desire for money or advantage, the darker shade
senses.definitionCN: 对钱财或利益的觊觎，词义的阴暗面
senses.example: He watched the bidding with cool avidity.
senses.exampleCN: 他冷冷而贪婪地盯着竞价。
senses.why: The same eagerness pointed at property turns greedy.
senses.whyCN: 同一份渴望指向财物时便转为贪婪。

senses.title: Keenness of a pursuit or study
senses.definition: sustained enthusiasm with which one follows a subject
senses.definitionCN: 长期投入某一学科或爱好所表现的持续热忱
senses.example: Her avidity for Roman coins filled the study.
senses.exampleCN: 她痴迷罗马钱币，藏品摆满了书房。
senses.why: Eagerness that lasts stops being appetite and becomes devotion.
senses.whyCN: 持续的渴望不再是胃口，而成了痴迷。

senses.title: In immunology, antibody-binding strength
senses.definition: the overall strength of binding between an antibody and its antigen
senses.definitionCN: 抗体与抗原之间结合的总体强度
senses.example: High avidity antibodies signal an older infection.
senses.exampleCN: 高亲合力抗体提示感染时间较久。
senses.why: Medicine borrowed the eagerness image: binding that will not let go.
senses.whyCN: 医学借用「紧抓不放」的意象命名结合强度。

senses.title: In chemistry, close to affinity
senses.definition: in older chemical writing, the mutual attraction of substances
senses.definitionCN: 旧化学文献中物质间的相互吸引
senses.example: Early texts ranked the avidity of acids for bases.
senses.exampleCN: 早期文献按酸对碱的亲合性排序。
senses.why: Before exact measures, attraction was described in appetite terms.
senses.whyCN: 在精确测量之前，人们用「胃口」来描述吸引。

senses.title: Competitive hunger in games or markets
senses.definition: aggressive eagerness to win, bid, or trade
senses.definitionCN: 取胜、竞价或交易中的猛烈冲劲
senses.example: The startup hired with an avidity that unsettled rivals.
senses.exampleCN: 那家创业公司招人猛冲猛打，令对手不安。
senses.why: Markets reward appetites; the word migrated there.
senses.whyCN: 市场奖励欲望，这个词也随行就市。

senses.title: Avidness of an audience
senses.definition: the eagerness of readers, fans, or crowds for a thing
senses.definitionCN: 读者、粉丝或人群对某物的热切追捧
senses.example: The sequel was awaited with feverish avidity.
senses.exampleCN: 续作在狂热的期待中呼之欲出。
senses.why: Appetite shared by many becomes an audience mood.
senses.whyCN: 众人之欲汇聚，便成了一种受众情绪。

intro.en: Avidity comes from Latin aviditas, from avidus, eager, from avere, to crave; English formed or borrowed the noun in the fifteenth century.
intro.cn: avidity 出自拉丁语 aviditas，源于 avidus「热切的」，词根为 avere「渴望」；英语名词约在 15 世纪形成或借入。

items.en: The crave-root is reconstructed as a stem of wishing or striving.
items.cn: 「渴望」词根被重构为表「希求、 striving」的词干。

items.en: avere meant to desire eagerly; avidus described the greedy, hungry mind.
items.cn: avere 意为热切渴望；avidus 形容饥渴、贪求之心。

items.en: aviditas named eagerness as a quality, often with moral disapproval.
items.cn: aviditas 指作为特质的渴望，常带道德贬义。

items.en: Middle English took avidity with the double sense of greed and eagerness.
items.cn: 中古英语借入 avidity，兼有贪婪与热切二义。

items.en: Scientific prose borrowed avidity for the mutual pull of substances.
items.cn: 17、18 世纪科学散文借 avidity 指物质间的相互吸引。

items.en: Immunology fixed avidity as a technical measure of antibody binding.
items.cn: 现代免疫学将 avidity 定为抗体结合强度的术语。

note.en: Group one gathers the avere family and an affinity trap; group two gathers the eagerness scale.
note.cn: 第一组收 avere 词族及 affinity 之辨；第二组收热切刻度上的词。

entries.definition: the adjective: an avid reader wants the next page now.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词：avid reader 指手不释卷的读者。

entries.definition: natural liking or attraction, from ad plus finis; do not swap with avidity in immunology, where the meanings differ.
entries.definitionCN: 天然好感或亲合，出自 ad + finis；免疫学中与 avidity 含义不同，勿混。

entries.definition: greed for wealth, the same eager root aimed at money.
entries.definitionCN: 贪财；同一「渴望」词根锁定在钱上。

entries.definition: the everyday word for keen desire.
insatiable appetite, the blunt negative twin.
entries.definitionCN: 永不满足的贪欲；直白的贬义孪生词。

entries.definition: physical or figurative hunger for something.
entries.definitionCN: 对某物的胃口，实指或虚指。

normalIntro.en: Keep the avere family in one breath: avere, avid, avidity, avarice.
normalIntro.cn: 一口气念完 avere 词族：avere、avid、avidity、avarice。

normal.en: avid plus -ity: the quality of being avid.
normal.cn: avid 加 -ity：即「热切」这一特质。

normal.en: An avid reader reads with avidity; the sentence twins them.
normal.cn: avid reader 配 read with avidity，成对记忆。

normal.en: The immunology term: avidity is grip strength for antibodies.
normal.cn: 免疫学术语：avidity 是抗体的「握力」。

normal.en: Negative shade: with avidity can imply greed in money contexts.
normal.cn: 贬义提示：金钱语境下 with avidity 可含贪婪。

normal.en: Spelling: avidity keeps the i before -ty, unlike avarice.
normal.cn: 拼写：avidity 在 -ty 前保留 i，别与 avarice 混。

abstract.en: See fingers already turning the next page.
abstract.cn: 看那手指已经去翻下一页。

abstract.en: Avidity is hunger that found a bookshelf.
abstract.cn: avidity 是找到了书架的饥饿。

abstract.en: Picture an antibody closing its fist on a molecule.
abstract.cn: 想象抗体把分子攥进拳头。

examples.en: He collected first editions with an avidity bordering on obsession.
examples.cn: 他搜罗初版书的热切近乎痴迷。

examples.en: The stray dogs ate with the avidity of the long unfed.
examples.cn: 流浪狗进食的贪婪显示它们饿了很久。

examples.en: Serum tests measured the avidity of her antibodies.
examples.cn: 血清检测测量了她抗体的亲合力。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「饿喂弟」——弟饿得两眼放光，那股狼吞虎咽的劲就是 avidity

root: 出自拉丁语 aviditas「渴望」，源自 avidus「热切的」，词根为 avere「热切渴望」，与 avarice 同源；15 世纪进入英语，兼有热切与贪婪二义；近代被化学借指亲合性，现代免疫学定名为抗体亲合力。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses track one eagerness through its registers: the reader's hunger, the eater's appetite, the miser's greed, the scholar's devotion, and the lab's measure of grip.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项追踪同一份渴望的不同语域：读者的饥渴、食者的胃口、守财奴的贪婪、学者的痴迷，以及实验室里的「握力」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands that reach before the eyes finish looking.
core.cn: 核心意象：眼睛还没看完，手已经伸了过去。

branches.en: THE NOBLE SIDE: eagerness for learning and lasting devotion.
branches.cn: 高雅一面：求知之渴与持久痴迷。

branches.en: THE APPETITE SIDE: eating bodies and eager crowds.
branches.cn: 胃口一面：进食之躯与热切人群。

branches.en: THE DARK SIDE: greed for gain and markets' hunger.
branches.cn: 阴暗一面：觊觎之贪与市场之渴。

branches.en: THE SCIENTIFIC SIDE: binding strength and chemical attraction.
branches.cn: 科学一面：结合强度与化学吸引。

branches.en: THE BODILY SIDE: the appetite that eats.

intro.en: Avidity is the adjective avidus plus the noun ending -itas, quality of being eager.
intro.cn: avidity 由形容词 avidus 加名词词尾 -itas 构成，义为「渴望」之质。

latinIntro.en: Latin -itas nouns name qualities, and English -ity keeps them alive by the hundred.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 -itas 名词命名性质，英语 -ity 成百上千地延续它们。

items.exampleCN: avarice 与 avidity 是同源表亲
